title: Tamago Nigiri
description: Soft layered Japanese omelet over lightly formed rice, secured with nori.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Whisk eggs, mirin, soy sauce and sugar. Cook gradually in folded layers over medium-low heat until fully set.
Cool briefly and cut into approximately 24 rectangular pieces.
Form 24 rice ovals, using roughly 25 g rice each.
Place omelet over each oval and wrap a slender strip of nori around the center to secure.
notes: The nori is used only as narrow securing bands, not full roll wrappers.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
